title: Malol language
description: Austronesian language of Papua New Guinea
extract: Malol is an Austronesian language of the Malol village area in Mainyen ward, West Aitape Rural LLG, coastal Sandaun Province, Papua New Guinea. Malol is spoken by an estimated 4,600 speakers.
